trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: CUDA integer tensors with dtype int8, int16, int32, or int64
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Tensor contains negative values and exponent is a positive integer such as 4; larger integer exponents may increase failure likelihood
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Synchronization or printing the result forces execution of the unsupported kernel
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: CUDA integer tensors containing negative values, pow with exponent 4, followed by synchronize or print.

root_cause.kernel_layer: Unsupported CUDA integer arithmetic kernel for pow with negative values

bug_oracle.description: Running pow on CUDA integer tensors containing negative values, then synchronizing or printing, raises an exception.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate integer tensor values to include negative values and boundary values such as -1 and INT_MIN.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create CUDA tensors with integer dtypes int8, int16, int32, and int64 and initialize them with signed values.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Vary exponent values including small and large positive integers such as 2, 3, 4, and 31, then force eager execution with synchronize or print.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply torch.Tensor.pow or an equivalent arithmetic operator to CUDA integer tensors, then call synchronize or print to trigger kernel execution.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Detect runtime exceptions or kernel failures after executing pow on negative integer CUDA tensors.
